title: ImUi Debug Draw Diag Smoke v1
problem: Close the diagnostics evidence gap for the public IMUI debug-draw cookbook proof by adding a promoted script and suite that launch the example, wait for stable root/canvas/metadata selectors, capture a screenshot, and capture a bundle.

repro.summary: Validate the promoted script/suite and run it with the cookbook example under diagnostics.
commands: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag script validate tools/diag-scripts/cookbook/imui-debug-draw-basics/cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics-smoke.json --json
FRET_DIAG=1 cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag suite cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics --launch -- cargo run -p fret-cookbook --features cookbook-imui,cookbook-diag --example imui_debug_draw_basics

gates.name: script validate
gates.command: cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag script validate tools/diag-scripts/cookbook/imui-debug-draw-basics/cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics-smoke.json --json

gates.name: diag suite run
gates.command: FRET_DIAG=1 cargo run -p fretboard-dev -- diag suite cookbook-imui-debug-draw-basics --launch -- cargo run -p fret-cookbook --features cookbook-imui,cookbook-diag --example imui_debug_draw_basics

continue_policy.notes: This diagnostics smoke slice is closed. Future debug-draw diagnostics should start as narrower follow-ons for layout sidecars, pixel checks, renderer attribution, or perf gates.
